name: Claude Code Agentic Architect 🧱
description_md:
# What You Get

- A single, plug-and-play prompt that analyzes any scenario and designs a complete 1–3 agent system end-to-end.

- Enforces a two-part output: (1) Required Agent Definitions (name, description, prompt for each) and (2) Initial Execution Prompt to run the whole workflow.

- Agent definitions mirror the “senior-editor” quality bar—tight roles, clear responsibilities, and production-ready prompts.

- Orchestrator section references agents by name and order, specifies the final deliverable, and is ready to paste into your runner.

- Works in Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT Projects—just paste and supply your scenario.

- Deliverable: the prompt text only (no extra files).Want even to level up your Claude Code game with a mega course?

Join Early AI-dopters: https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
